prompt: Ultra-realistic smartphone photograph of a woman walking along a secluded beach at dusk, captured in a vertical frame with an on-camera flash that creates the look of an authentic, spur-of-the-moment snapshot. The scene takes place beside the shoreline as the last traces of a deep crimson sunset fade into an almost black night sky. Behind her, dark ocean waves roll onto the sand, leaving bright white foam illuminated by the flash. The setting has a moody coastal atmosphere with cool sea breeze, subtle motion, and the feeling of an unplanned evening moment. Her facial details remain softly blurred by motion and wind, adding realism and mystery. She wears a flowing black maxi dress with delicate spaghetti straps that moves naturally with the breeze, accentuating a graceful hourglass silhouette. High-detail textures, realistic flash reflections, natural skin tones, subtle motion blur, cinematic coastal lighting, authentic smartphone photography, premium lifestyle editorial aesthetic.

promptZh: 一张超写实的智能手机照片，拍摄了一位 女性 在黄昏时分沿着 僻静海滩 漫步的场景。画面采用竖构图，机顶闪光灯营造出一种真实、随性的抓拍感。场景位于海岸边，深红色的余晖正逐渐褪去，融入近乎漆黑的夜空。她身后，深色的海浪拍打着沙滩，闪光灯照亮了明亮的白色泡沫。整个环境呈现出忧郁的海岸氛围，伴随着凉爽的海风、细微的动态感，以及一种不期而遇的夜晚氛围。一阵强风将她极长的秀发戏剧性地吹过脸庞，零散的发丝遮住了部分五官。她本能地抬起一只手拨开头发，同时继续前行，营造出一种抓拍的动态感，而非摆拍的时尚大片。她的面部细节因动态和风吹而略显模糊，增添了真实感与神秘感。她身着一件 飘逸的黑色长裙，细肩带随风自然摆动，勾勒出优雅的沙漏型身材。高细节纹理、真实的闪光灯反射、自然的肤色、细微的动态模糊、电影感海岸光影、地道的智能手机摄影风格、高端生活方式编辑美学。
